milestones.claim: The canonical pre_review_check result is verifier-owned, signed, hash-bound and deterministic.
milestones.doneMeans: Production CLI, read-only diagnostics and lifecycle share one verifier; a complete current artifact passes and every field tamper, replay, stale binding or caller-authored verdict fails with stable codes.

milestones.claim: DEV-to-REVIEW recomputes the current-worktree basis and reconciles every planned path to actual discovery.
milestones.doneMeans: Complete exact, expanded or approved-replaced paths pass; missing, partial, unsupported, stale, adapter-omitted, record-tampered or basis-backed topology omission cases fail closed.

milestones.claim: Executable producer-consumer evidence, mutation polarity, transcripts, authority and freshness are mechanically admissible.
milestones.doneMeans: Real chain and clean controls pass; every adverse mutation bites; exact restoration passes; weak authority, unrelated transcript, stale evidence, after-cutoff evidence or silent rebind fails.

milestones.claim: DEV-to-REVIEW consumes the canonical pre-review result and fresh independent critic re-attestation under flat project observe/warn/enforce modes without later-wave leakage.
milestones.doneMeans: Enforce blocks failing checks or stale/self-authored critic re-attestation, observe/warn preserve diagnostics and rollback, process-fact contract bites at all layers, and no Wave 3A or Wave 4 behavior is present.
